strict_source_only.field_information: target RGB excluded from reconstruction, feature field training, query construction, and selection
strict_source_only.prompt: official raw positive and negative scribbles only

classifier.feature: L2-normalized exact official C-RADIO-derived DINOv3 capability rows; no hash or prototype compression
classifier.population: every capability-valid row with nonzero exact signed scribble evidence
classifier.sample_weight: absolute signed evidence times W-transpose-one, normalized independently within each sign
classifier.covariance: class-balanced pooled weighted diagonal within-class covariance
classifier.logit: w dot z minus one-half w dot (mu_positive plus mu_negative)
classifier.probability: sigmoid of the unscaled discriminant logit
classifier.insufficient_population: fail closed unless both signs have at least 32 valid rows and positive weight

continuous_energy.graph: frozen canonical shared k16 symmetric geometry-times-DINO-times-SAM raw affinity
continuous_energy.query_edge: raw affinity times sqrt(g_i*g_j), followed by recomputed symmetric degree normalization
continuous_energy.hard_seed_normalization: positive and negative exact adjoint masses independently divided by their sign maximum
continuous_energy.output: continuous probability clipped only for floating point roundoff

strict_source_only.invalid_capability_rows: zero except exact normalized hard-positive anchors; hard-negative anchors remain zero

published_compatible_all_view.required_information: all registered RGB views may contribute to query-free reconstruction and feature uplift, matching the reproduced LUDVIG information condition
published_compatible_all_view.separation_rule: a source-only canonical field or source-only SAM completion may not be relabeled as this track
published_compatible_all_view.current_action: report separately; do not synthesize an all-view field from strict assets

sentinel.gate: macro greater than 0.61389329, at least one scene improves, and neither scene regresses by more than 0.03

forbidden: target mask or IoU before selector and score freeze
